digest.en: Renewed hostilities are flaring in the Middle East. Iranian FM warned foreign forces face a "constant risk" of being caught in the crossfire. The EU is also considering sanctions on Russian officials.
digest.hi: नरेंद्र मोदी आज नई दिल्ली में एनडीए की बैठक में शक्ति प्रदर्शन करेंगे। वह भारत के सबसे लंबे समय तक सत्ता संभालने वाले निर्वाचित प्रधानमंत्री बन गए हैं। वैश्विक नेताओं ने उन्हें बधाई दी है।

articles.title: Renewed hostilities in the Middle East is a question of when, not if
articles.summary: James M Dorsey of the S Rajaratnam School of International Studies says tit-for-tat strikes between Israel and Iran have stopped. However, both countries have left the door open to renewed hostilities. Dorsey notes that the question is no longer if hostilities will resume, but when. Israel and Iran are waiting for the right opportunity to strike again. Tit-for-tat strikes may have stopped, but Israel and Iran have left the door open to a renewal of hostilities whenever the opportunity arises, says James M Dorsey of the S Rajaratnam School of International Studies.

articles.title: Trump Says US Responds To Downing Of Helicopter With 'Very Powerful' Strikes On Iran
articles.summary: The United States launched self-defense strikes against Iran on June 9. President Donald Trump said the response was necessary after Iranian forces downed a US Army Apache helicopter on June 8. The US strikes were described as very powerful by Trump. Iran was targeted just hours after the helicopter incident. The United States said it launched "self-defense" strikes against Iran on June 9 just hours after President Donald Trump said Washington was compelled to respond to the downing of a US Army Apache helicopter by Iranian forces a day earlier.

articles.title: EU Considering Sanctions On Russian Orthodox Patriarch, Chess Federation Chief, Others
articles.summary: The European Union is considering financial sanctions against the head of the Russian Orthodox Church. Other targets include the Russian head of the world chess federation and a historian advising President Putin. These measures target top Russian officials. The European Union is calling for financial sanctions on the head of the Russian Orthodox Church, the Russian head of the world chess federation, a historian who is a close adviser to President Vladimir Putin, and other top officials.

articles.title: Hold Pakistan accountable for crackdown in PoK: MEA urges international community
articles.summary: India urged the international community to hold Pakistan accountable for its actions in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir. Protests began on June 5 in Muzaffarabad and other cities. Residents demanded subsidies and civil liberties. The latest protest that started under the leadership of Jammu Kashmir Joint Awami Action Committee (JAAC) on June 5 however was triggered when local residents demanded subsidy on electricity and flour and restoration of civil liberties in Muzaffarabad, Rawalkot, and Mirpur.

articles.title: Iran FM says foreign forces face ‘constant risk’ of being caught in crossfire
articles.summary: Iran's Foreign Minister stated foreign forces face constant risk in the region. He advised their departure as the best solution. This follows U. S. accusations of Iran shooting down a helicopter. “To reduce risk, best solution is for them to leave,” Abbas Araghchi added, after U. President Donald Trump vowed a response following accusations that Iran shot down an Apache helicopter over the Strait of Hormuz a day earlier.

articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi is expected to meet President Trump on the sidelines of the G7 summit in The PM’s visit to France will take place in two segments, with the first segment stretching from June 13 to June 14, and the second taking place from June 16 to June 19; he will hold a meeting with Mr. Macron on June 14.

articles.title: Ex-CIA disguise chief says AI elevates spy wars to new heights
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence has significantly advanced espionage capabilities. Spy agencies can better identify human sources. Adversaries now use synthetic identities and deepfakes, expanding threats beyond traditional cyberattacks. Artificial intelligence (AI) has sharpened the tools of espionage and deception on all sides, giving spy agencies new power to identify and groom human sources while also arming adversaries with synthetic identities and deepfakes that are increasingly difficult to detect.

articles.title: Taliban Security Forces Fire On Afghan Women's Rights Protesters
articles.summary: Taliban security forces fired on women’s rights protesters in Herat on June 9. The demonstration was against the arrest of women accused of violating the mandatory dress code. An eyewitness reported at least one person was killed. Afghan Talliban forces used gunfire to disperse a women’s rights protest in the western city of Herat on June 9 after residents demonstrated against the recent arrest of women accused of violating the mandatory dress code.

articles.title: Cuban President outlines ‘three scenarios’ U.S. may take
articles.summary: Cuban President Miguel Diaz-Canel stated the United States is pursuing three potential scenarios against Cuba. One scenario involves economic pressure to incite social unrest. This unrest could then be used as a pretext for U. S. intervention under the guise of humanitarian aid. “They are betting on three scenarios, one scenario is through economic strangulation to provoke social unrest, and for that social unrest to then give them the chance, under the pretext of humanitarian aid, to intervene,” says Miguel Diaz-Canel.

articles.title: Panic Buying In Russian-Occupied Crimea Amid Transportation Crisis, Fuel Shortages
articles.summary: Residents in Russian-occupied Crimea report empty grocery shelves and purchase limits on basic goods. Residents of Russian-occupied Crimea are reporting empty shelves in grocery stores and purchase limits on a number of basic goods. This comes amid a regional transportation collapse and fuel shortages caused by Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian oil refineries and vital infrastructure. articles.summary: American negotiators discussed an interim trade agreement in New Delhi this week. Even as American negotiators were sitting across the table in New Delhi this week discussing the contours of an interim trade agreement, Washington simultaneously unveiled additional Section 301 tariff proposals against India and 60 other countries. articles.title: Fresh strikes on Tyre kill eight, as UN puts Lebanon destruction bill at $365 million, and rising
articles.summary: The United Nations reported that Lebanon has sustained over $365 million in building damage in Beirut and Mount Lebanon since the recent escalation. Fresh strikes in Tyre killed eight people. This assessment highlights the ongoing destruction despite a ceasefire. The fighting continues to impact civilian areas. Lebanon has suffered more than $365 million in damage to buildings across Beirut and Mount Lebanon since the latest escalation, according to a new UN-led assessment released on Tuesday, as fresh strikes in Tyre underscored the fragility of a ceasefire that has failed to stop the fighting.

articles.title: Marking historic progress on rights for persons with disabilities, UN conference tackles critical
articles.summary: The 19th global meeting on the rights of persons with disabilities commenced at UN Headquarters on Tuesday. The UN chief acknowledged historic progress in this area. Historical gains have been hard-won, but much more needs to be done to advance progress in realising promises made two decades ago, said the UN chief at the opening on Tuesday of the 19th global meeting on the rights of persons with disabilities at UN Headquarters.

articles.title: Palestinians face systematic abuse by Israeli settlers and Hamas alike: Independent investigators
articles.summary: Palestinian civilians face systematic abuse from both Israeli settlers and Hamas, according to a new report by UN Human Rights Council investigators. The report details escalating settler violence in the occupied West Bank. It also highlights fear-based Hamas rule in the Gaza Strip. These conditions leave Palestinians trapped between two oppressive forces. Palestinian civilians are trapped between escalating settler violence in the occupied West Bank and fear-based Hamas rule in the Gaza Strip, investigators appointed by the UN Human Rights Council said on Tuesday in a new report.

articles.title: China’s grip tightening on Pakistan’s digital future
articles.summary: China’s cooperation with Pakistan through the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor is shifting. For nearly a decade, the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor (CPEC) was defined by heavy concrete, coal-fired power plants and the asphalt of the Karakoram Highway. The cooperation dealt primarily with the physical realities of geography and infrastructure, addressing critical shortages in Pakistan’s economy while giving China an expanded strategic footprint in South Asia.

articles.title: Powerful earthquake in southern Philippines leaves at least 37 dead
articles.summary: A magnitude-7.8 earthquake struck the southern Philippines early Monday. At least 19 people died. Buildings collapsed. articles.title: Two US pilots killed after plane bound to pick up former MLB star crashes
articles.summary: A U. S. registered plane crashed in the Dominican Republic on 2 March 2024. The pilot and co-pilot died in the incident. The aircraft was en route to pick up former MLB star Yadier Molina and his family. Molina stated on social media the plane was headed to Texas. Plane on way to pick up Yadier Molina and his family crashed in Dominican Republic, killing pilot and co-pilotA pilot and co-pilot from the United States have died in a fiery plane crash as they attempted an emergency landing in the Dominican Republic, authorities said. Former major league baseball all-star catcher Yadier Molina said on social media that the plane was bound for Texas to pick him up.

articles.title: Oil On The Beach But No Fuel For Cars: Tourist Season Opens In Crimea
articles.summary: The summer tourist season began in Russian-occupied Crimea. The summer tourist season is starting in Russian-occupied Crimea, but with Ukrainian drone attacks and fuel shortages, how many people will visit? Current Time correspondent Andrey Cherkasov explains, tour operators are trying to put a positive spin on the crisis, but it's being met with skepticism. Oil On The Beach But No Fuel For Cars: Tourist Season Opens In Crimea.

articles.title: HK and Bangkok step aside, Vienna’s claim as spy capital is strong
articles.summary: Egisto Ott, a former Austrian intelligence officer, was sentenced to prison for passing classified information to Russia. Ott, 63, worked for the Federal Office for the Protection of the Constitution and Counterterrorism. He allegedly shared details about Austrian security operations with Russian intelligence services. The case has raised questions about Vienna's role as a hub for espionage. Egisto Ott is no James Bond.

articles.title: ‘Rare, untreatable strain’: Ebola toll mounts in eastern DR Congo
articles.summary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's eastern provinces has reached 515 confirmed cases. The UN's top aid official visited Ituri province, the outbreak's center. The strain is described as rare and untreatable. The top UN aid official in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is in Ituri province – the epicentre of the country's Ebola outbreak – for a three-day assessment visit, as the confirmed case count reaches 515 across three eastern provinces.

articles.title: आते-जाते लोगों को ठोकता था सलाम, फिर सिक्योरिटी गार्ड की लगी बंपर लॉटरी, करोड़पति बनते ही 2 चीजें
articles.summary: अबू धाबी में एक सिक्योरिटी गार्ड की लॉटरी लगी, 26 वर्षीय तैयब खान करोड़पति बन गए। अबू धाबी में पिछले चार साल से मामूली सिक्योरिटी गार्ड की नौकरी करने वाले 26 वर्षीय तैयब खान की किस्मत रातों-रात ऐसे पलटी कि करोड़पति बन गए. नेपाल के रहने वाले तैयब ने अपने पांच दोस्तों के साथ मिलकर महज 50 दिरहम में लॉटरी का टिकट खरीदा था, जिसने उन्हें और उनकी पूरी टोली को मालामाल कर दिया.

articles.title: पाकिस्तान में पानी की एक बूंद भी नहीं जाएगी, अमित शाह खुद कर रहे निगरानी, सिंधु जल संधि पर भारत का
articles.summary: भारत ने पिछले साल 22 अप्रैल को कश्मीर में हुए आतंकवादी हमले के बाद पाकिस्तान के खिलाफ सिंधु जल संधि को स्थगित कर दिया था। यह संधि 1960 में विश्व बैंक की मध्यस्थता से हुई थी और जल वितरण को नियंत्रित करती है। भारत ने पिछले साल 22 अप्रैल को दक्षिण कश्मीर के पहलगाम में आतंकवादियों द्वारा किये गए हमले और 26 लोगों की हत्या के अगले दिन पाकिस्तान के खिलाफ उठाए गए कदमों के तहत 1960 की सिंधु जल संधि को स्थगित कर दिया था.

articles.title: महिला दवा तक को मोहताज, एक्स-हसबैंड 19 करोड़ दबाए बैठा था, तलाक की अर्जी पर कोर्ट में खुले अय्याशी
articles.summary: चीन की एक महिला ने आरोप लगाया कि उसके पूर्व पति ने 19 करोड़ रुपये छिपाए, तलाक के दौरान खुली अय्याशी। चीन की 53 साल महिला वांग ने आरोप लगाया है कि उसके पूर्व पति ने तलाक के दौरान करीब 19 करोड़ रुपये की संपत्ति छिपाकर रखी थी. लेकिन इलाज के लिए उसे पैसे नहीं दिये गए. वांग ने बताया कि शादी के दौरान उसे कभी परिवार की असली आर्थिक स्थिति के बारे में नहीं बताया गया.

articles.title: 'अपाचे का बदला लेगा अमेरिका', ईरान पर अटैक करने वाले हैं ट्रंप? एक लाइन लिखकर मचा दिया हड़कंप
articles.summary: अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप ने ईरान द्वारा अपाचे हेलिकॉप्टर गिराए जाने का दावा किया है। उन्होंने गंभीर परिणाम भुगतने की चेतावनी दी है। ईरान के वरिष्ठ नेता ने कहा कि अमेरिका को अपने कार्यों के परिणाम भुगतने होंगे। अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप ने दावा किया है कि ईरान ने होर्मुज जलडमरूमध्य के ऊपर गश्त लगा रहे अमेरिकी सेना के एक अपाचे हेलिकॉप्टर को मार गिराया है.

articles.title: G7 में ट्रंप से होगी पीएम मोदी की मुलाकात? तेल से भारत-अमेरिका ट्रेड डील तक, इन मुद्दों पर हो सकता
articles.summary: प्रधानमंत्री मोदी और अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति ट्रंप की G7 समिट में मुलाकात हो सकती है, ट्रेड डील पर बातचीत होगी। फ्रांस के इवियन शहर में 16 और 17 जून 2026 को होने वाली G7 समिट में प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी का जाना पक्का हो गया है, जिससे अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप के साथ उनकी मुलाकात की अटकलें तेज हो गई हैं. अगर दोनों नेता मिलते हैं, तो अटकी हुई महा-ट्रेड डील, रूस से तेल की खरीद, ऊर्जा सुरक्षा और आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस जैसे बड़े मुद्दों पर अहम बातचीत हो सकती है.
